description: This Java source file defines an abstract class AbstractPersistenceSupervisor that manages sharded persistent actors with restart, shutdown, and error handling logic using Akka actor framework.

classes.name: AbstractPersistenceSupervisor
classes.description: An abstract Akka actor class supervising sharded persistent actors with restart and error handling logic, parameterized by EntityId type.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve the entity ID this supervisor manages.

methods.name: getPersistenceActorProps
methods.description: Abstract method to get Props for creating the child persistence actor.

methods.name: getExponentialBackOffConfig
methods.description: Abstract method to read backoff configuration from system settings.

methods.name: getShutdownBehaviour
methods.description: Abstract method to determine shutdown behavior for the supervisor.

methods.name: getUnavailableExceptionBuilder
methods.description: Abstract method to create exception builder for entity unavailability.

methods.name: supervisorStrategy
methods.description: Returns default stopping strategy for child actors.

methods.name: preStart
methods.description: Initializes entity ID, child props, shutdown behavior, and starts child actor; handles exceptions.

methods.name: createReceive
methods.description: Defines default message handling during startup.

methods.name: becomeActive
methods.description: Transitions actor to active state with message handling for child termination, passivation, and message forwarding.

methods.name: becomeCorrupted
methods.description: Transitions actor to corrupted state with timeout and error reply handling.

methods.name: passivate
methods.description: Requests parent to passivate (shutdown) the child actor.

methods.name: startChild
methods.description: Starts the child persistence actor if not already active.

methods.name: childTerminated
methods.description: Handles child termination, logs, and schedules restart with exponential backoff.

methods.name: getCorruptedReceiveTimeout
methods.description: Calculates receive timeout during corrupted state with randomness.

methods.name: calculateRestartDelay
methods.description: Calculates delay before restarting child, using exponential backoff logic.

methods.name: calculateNextBackOff
methods.description: Computes next backoff duration within min and max bounds.

methods.name: randomize
methods.description: Returns a randomized duration based on base duration and factor.

methods.name: boundDuration
methods.description: Ensures duration stays within min and max bounds.

methods.name: forwardToChildIfAvailable
methods.description: Forwards messages to child actor or replies with exception if unavailable.

methods.name: replyUnavailableException
methods.description: Replies to sender with an exception indicating entity unavailability.

methods.name: warnAboutMessagesDuringStartup
methods.description: Logs warning for messages received during startup.
